text.content:
Lionized

  • Whenever you cause a creature to become lionized, choose one of its attributes (Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, Presence) to extol. The lionized creature can add a bonus 1d4 to the result of attack rolls and checks that use the chosen attribute. 
  • Lionized does not stack. If a creature gains the lionized condition while already lionized, the effect with the longer duration remains. When this happens, it can also change which attribute is affected.
